description: This file defines a custom Markdown renderer class 'Renderer' extending 'marked.Renderer', with methods for rendering code blocks, inline code, images, links, headings, tables, lists, and text formatting, tailored for Mattermost's web application. It also includes helper functions for HTML entity unescaping.

classes.name: Renderer
classes.description: A custom Markdown renderer class for rendering Markdown content with specific HTML structures, link handling, and search term highlighting tailored for Mattermost.

methods.name: code
methods.description: Renders code blocks, handling LaTeX, search term highlighting, and HTML escaping.

methods.name: codespan
methods.description: Renders inline code spans with search term highlighting.

methods.name: br
methods.description: Overrides line break rendering, returning space if singleline option is set.

methods.name: image
methods.description: Renders images with optional dimensions and proxy handling.

methods.name: link
methods.description: Renders links with safety checks, search highlighting, and target attributes.

methods.name: paragraph
methods.description: Renders paragraphs, using span instead of p for inline images if singleline is set.

methods.name: table
methods.description: Renders tables wrapped in responsive div.

methods.name: tablecell
methods.description: Renders table cells, extending marked's renderer.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Renders ordered and unordered lists with custom styles.

methods.name: listitem
methods.description: Renders list items, including task list checkboxes.

methods.name: text
methods.description: Renders inline text with formatting and emoji processing.
